review_method: Manual reading of six official NASA image-detail pages; this is an editorial source-page audit, not media reuse clearance or a downloaded photograph license.
identity_note: NASA image-detail pages provide a labeled PIA Number for records 02-06; the separate Apollo 1 Crew Honored page does not state a PIA/catalog number. S67-19766 therefore remains provisional.

records.evidence_scope: A NASA crew portrait near Launch Complex 34, not a depiction of cabin conditions, fire or ignition.
records.limitation: NASA's linked image-detail page does not provide a structured S67-19766 catalog identity.

records.evidence_scope: Command Module 012 being moved for mating to its adapter, not a measurement of test-cabin oxygen or pressure.
records.limitation: Photograph preparation date is not the date of the January 27 fire.

records.evidence_scope: The Apollo 1 crew entering or standing beside an altitude chamber during October 1966 training.
records.limitation: Not a photograph of the January 27, 1967 cabin fire or instrument sequence.

records.evidence_scope: A 2017 tribute exhibit containing a spacecraft mockup and hatch-related displays.
records.limitation: A retrospective exhibit, not a contemporary view inside the 1967 spacecraft during the fire.

records.evidence_scope: Interior damage to Command Module 012 after the accident.
records.limitation: A damage photograph cannot establish a unique ignition mechanism.

records.evidence_scope: A 2017 tribute display featuring an Apollo spacecraft redesigned hatch.
records.limitation: The exhibit demonstrates a later design, not a photographed 1967 escape attempt.
